title: betula pendula subsp. szechuanica
intro: Betula pendula subsp. szechuanica, commonly known as the Sichuan Birch, is a subspecies of the Birch tree native to China. It is a deciduous tree known for its ornamental value, with a distinctive white trunk and delicate leaves. The Sichuan Birch is valued for its medicinal properties, providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits of lowering blood pressure, and aiding in digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes.
